findings.mechanism: Read-modify-write without SELECT ... FOR UPDATE or atomic UPDATE leads to lost updates under READ COMMITTED isolation.
findings.remediation: Use SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the Shipment row or replace the increment with an atomic UPDATE statement (e.g., UPDATE shipment SET delivery_count = delivery_count + 1) and run in SERIALIZABLE isolation.
findings.arithmetic: Starting delivery_count=0. With 3 concurrent calls, each reads 0, increments to 1, commits. Final delivery_count = 1 (lost 2 updates).
